method: Every row fact and every club fact was checked against at least two independent published source domains. The evidence sets are recorded separately so a citation for one clue can never be reused as proof of the other. Only positive facts are included.
notes: The board label says market value exceeded 100 million euros, so exact 100 million cases are excluded even though the current validator prompt defines the threshold as inclusive.
The original publisher's archived Luka Modric overall page is not directly accessible. His exact standard 2019 overall of 91 is corroborated by multiple independent historical databases and reports.
rows: Scored in a Champions League Final
